title: Rendlesham Forest incident near Europe's largest nuclear stockpile

tellings.quote: look no further than the Rendlessham Forest incident [music] in 1980.

plain: In 1980 something happened in Rendlesham Forest in England, near what is described as Europe's largest stockpile of nuclear weapons, and it is known as the Rendlesham Forest incident. Michels points to it himself as an example ("look no further than"), without naming a source, on an episode about Air Force veterans who say they were abducted by aliens. He offers it as a case where UFOs and nuclear weapons appear together.
